The C# code exactly matches the [C++ implementation](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/7b9c5122faafb6b4a655e31ae27bcffeb5cf254f/core/string/ustring.cpp#L5508-L5516) so it looks good to me. This changes behavior but I don't think anyone would've been relying on the old behavior.

- The original C++ code was changed in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/7525.
